lines.en: label day44:
scene town2_noon
This town has two halves.
lines.zh: 这座小镇有两半。

lines.en: There’s the normal half with the[school], the cafe, and the countless other shops and locations where I'm normally content with wasting away my days.
lines.zh: 一半是正常的那一半，有[school]、有咖啡馆，还有无数别的店铺和场所，我平日里都很乐意在那些地方消磨日子。

lines.en: And then there’s this half.
lines.zh: 然后就是这一半。

lines.en: This half is made up of low-income housing and dilapidated buildings that were once full of life.
lines.zh: 这一半由低收入住宅和曾经充满生机的破败建筑组成。

lines.en: Now, there’s barely anything.
lines.zh: 现在，这里几乎什么都没了。

lines.en: ‘How do I know this,’ you ask?
lines.zh: 「我怎么知道的？」你问。

lines.en: A good question.
lines.zh: 好问题。

lines.en: I feel like just the other day, I was being lectured by my niece about the variety of locations I'd need to memorize in order to survive here.
lines.zh: 感觉就在前几天，我还被我的[niece]念叨过，要想在这里活下去，得记住哪些地方。

lines.en: But this location was omitted from the list.
lines.zh: 但这个地方被从那份名单上漏掉了。

lines.en: if chikadorm10 == True:
Instead, I learned about this half of town from Chika.
lines.zh: 而我是从 Chika 那里知道这半边城的。

lines.en: It was the night we watched TV together.
lines.zh: 是我们一起看电视的那个晚上。

lines.en: I distinctly remember the shape of her thighs and the idea of pulling them apart before bringing her to orgasm with my tongue.
lines.zh: 我清楚地记得她大腿的形状，还有把那双腿分开、用舌头把她送上高潮的念头。

lines.en: Of course, that was all just an idea.
lines.zh: 当然，那一切都只是个念头。

lines.en: None of it ever happened.
lines.zh: 什么都没发生。

lines.en: And that makes me very sad.
lines.zh: 这让我非常难过。

lines.en: She should give me permission to perform oral sex on her whenever I want.
lines.zh: 她应该允许我随时为她口交。

lines.en: I think it would bring the two of us closer together.
lines.zh: 我觉得那会让我们两个更亲近。

lines.en: else:
Thankfully, I remembered it all on my own today.
lines.zh: 幸好，这些我今天全靠自己想起来了。

lines.en: Or...at least it feels like I remembered it.
lines.zh: 或者……至少感觉像是自己想起来的。

lines.en: It's hard to recollect memories you've never had in the first place, but much easier to collect the ones that someone else let slip out of their hands.
lines.zh: 要回忆起你从来就不曾拥有过的记忆很难，但要捡起别人不小心漏掉的那些，就容易多了。

lines.en: That's precisely what happened with my name- another seemingly important detail about myself that I'm unable to remember.
lines.zh: 我的名字正是这种情况——又一个我记不起来、看似很重要的个人信息。

lines.en: But that’s okay.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。

lines.en: Being Sensei is easier.
lines.zh: 当 Sensei 更轻松。

lines.en: And I will hold onto that thought for dear life, for I'd feel simply horrible if someone were to have to pick up after me.
lines.zh: 而我会死死抱住这个念头，因为要是有人不得不来替我收拾残局，我会难过死的。

lines.en: : I wonder if there’s anything to do around here?
lines.zh: : 不知道这附近有没有什么可干的？

lines.en: I speak to myself while kicking a rock down the street.
lines.zh: 我一边自言自语，一边把一颗石子沿街踢着走。

lines.en: I told Ami I had plans today, so we weren’t able to go home together.
lines.zh: 我跟 Ami 说今天有安排，所以没能和她一起回家。

lines.en: Of course, my ‘plans’ consisted of getting mildly lost in unfamiliar territory, waiting for something to cross my path as if to say ‘You’re finally here.’
lines.zh: 当然，我的「安排」就是在一片陌生的地方小范围迷路，等着什么东西横在我的面前，仿佛在说「你终于来了」。

lines.en: But after an hour or so of wandering around this place-
lines.zh: 但在这地方转了差不多一个小时后——

lines.en: I’m not anywhere.
lines.zh: 我哪儿也没到。

lines.en: scene theskyisgod
No one is anywhere.
lines.zh: 谁也不在任何地方。

lines.en: At least not in this half of town.
lines.zh: 至少这半边城没有。

scene yumi1
: What are you doing here?...
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？……

lines.en: A girl sits with her back pressed against a wooden barrier constructed to prevent people from falling to their deaths.
lines.zh: 一个女孩背靠着一道木头护栏坐着，那护栏是为了防止人摔下去摔死而建的。

lines.en: I suppress the urge to push her over and respond.
lines.zh: 我压下把她推下去的冲动，回答了她。

lines.en: : Hey, Yumi. Nice to see you.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Yumi。见到你真高兴。

lines.en: : No it ain't. And I asked you a question, numnuts. What are you doing here?...
lines.zh: : 高兴个屁。我问你话呢，蠢货。你在这儿干什么？……

lines.en: : Just...walking around. Is that a problem?
lines.zh: : 就是……随便走走。这也有问题？

lines.en: : Yeah...it is. You’re not supposed to be here.
lines.zh: : 对……有问题。你不该来这儿。

lines.en: : I’m not? Why?
lines.zh: : 我不该？为什么？

lines.en: scene yumi2
: Because there’s no fucking reason for you to be here...and there will never be a reason for that in the first place.
lines.zh: : 因为你他妈根本没有任何理由待在这儿……而且一开始就不可能有理由。

lines.en: : The fuck even is this? Don't tell me you're stalking me again or some shit, because I swear to-
lines.zh: : 这到底算什么？别告诉我你又在跟踪我什么的，因为我发誓——

lines.en: : I wasn’t stalking you...Besides, how would I have even known you were here? You didn't show up to school today.
lines.zh: : 我没有跟踪你……再说了，我怎么会知道你在这儿？你今天都没去学校。

lines.en: scene yumi3
: That ain't ever stopped you from finding me before.
lines.zh: : 这以前也没妨碍过你找到我啊。

lines.en: A moment of silence climbs up the wall behind Yumi and slips in through the barrier, wrapping itself around her legs and forcing her to pause for a moment as her mind figures out how to dispose of it.
lines.zh: 一阵沉默顺着 Yumi 身后的墙爬上来，钻过护栏，缠住了她的双腿，逼得她停顿片刻，好让脑子想出该怎么把它甩掉。

lines.en: I should be afraid, yet I am too caught up in envying the intangible being as I, too, wish to be wrapped around Yumi's legs.
lines.zh: 我本该害怕，可我却只顾着嫉妒那个无形的存在，因为我也想缠在 Yumi 的腿上。

lines.en: There are many things I wish to do to Yumi. There are many things I wish that she would do to me.
lines.zh: 我想对 Yumi 做的事有很多。我想让她对我做的事也有很多。

lines.en: If only I could turn invisible.
lines.zh: 要是我能隐身就好了。

lines.en: If only I could twist myself into vines.
lines.zh: 要是我能把自己扭成藤蔓就好了。

lines.en: : You...don't even know why I'm here, do you?
lines.zh: : 你……根本不知道我为什么在这儿，对吧？

lines.en: : Why would I?
lines.zh: : 我怎么会知道？

lines.en: : I don’t know anything about you...let alone why you’d be hanging out in the middle of nowhere right before nightfall.
lines.zh: : 我对你一无所知……更别说你为什么在天快黑的时候跑到这种鸟不拉屎的地方来晃。

lines.en: : That can be easily changed, though. It just requires you actually...you know, talking to me.
lines.zh: : 不过这很容易改变。只需要你真的……你知道的，跟我说说话。

lines.en: Yumi, who appears to be on the verge of slipping into an uncharacteristic bout of despondency right now, takes a moment to ponder over something.
lines.zh: Yumi 此刻似乎眼看就要陷入一阵与她性格不符的消沉，她停下来思考着什么。

lines.en: When she speaks again, her voice is an octave or two lower than normal.
lines.zh: 当她再次开口时，声音比平时低了一两个八度。

lines.en: : I've got my reasons, okay?

lines.en: : I’m going back to the dorms soon, so just...
lines.zh: : 我马上就回宿舍了，所以你就……
